init_incremental_state: init a FairseqIncrementalState instance to generate a unique incremental state UUID for an nn.Module
get_incremental_state: get the incremental state dictionary for a given key from an nn.Module's incremental state store
set_incremental_state: set the incremental state dictionary for a given key in an nn.Module's incremental state store
get_full_incremental_state_key: get the full namespaced incremental state key by combining a UUID with a user-provided key string
with_incremental_state_decorator: apply the with_incremental_state decorator to a class to add FairseqIncrementalState as a base class
